description: This file contains utility functions for handling module specifiers, inventory comparisons, and file system interactions in a TypeScript/JavaScript project. It provides functions for path normalization, resolving specifiers, traversing module dependency trees, and running inventory checks.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Converts an absolute or relative file path into a normalized repository-relative path with forward slashes.

methods.name: resolveRepoSpecifier
methods.description: Resolves a module specifier to a repository-relative path, considering relative or absolute specifiers.

methods.name: visitModuleSpecifiers
methods.description: Traverses a source file's syntax tree, invoking a callback for each module specifier found in import, export, or dynamic import statements.

methods.name: diffInventoryEntries
methods.description: Compares two inventories and returns the missing and unexpected entries based on a comparison function.

methods.name: writeLine
methods.description: Writes a line of text to a stream.

methods.name: collectTypeScriptInventory
methods.description: Collects inventory entries from multiple TypeScript files by parsing their source content.

methods.name: runBaselineInventoryCheck
methods.description: Performs a baseline check of the current inventory against expected entries and outputs the comparison results.
